purpose: Teach: ダブル/ショット/直感/展覧/演じる/細い/逃げる/助ける

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祝いに、絶対、ダブル、絶対、サイズの、絶対、アイス、絶対、頼みたいわ
lines.en: Sho, I really want to celebrate with you — a double-size ice cream, okay?
lines.style: Warm, direct affection wrapped in a small request. Gentle rise on the proposal, landing softly. The voice of someone who's already planned this surprise.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、運動会の、絶対、ショット、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、撮ってくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad actually got a shot of me at the sports day. A really good one.
lines.style: Quiet pride breaking through. Slight lift when he mentions the photo — he's been waiting to share this. Genuine, no performance, just the joy of having evidence that someone noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お友達の気持ち、絶対、直感、絶対、で、絶対、わかることが、絶対、あるわ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, sometimes you just understand how a friend feels without them having to explain it. That intuition is real.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself at first. Slow, measuring beat. Then a gentle turn back to him, like she's discovered something while speaking and wants him to know.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、絵の、絶対、展覧、絶対、会、絶対、行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, will you go with me to the art exhibition? I really want to go.
lines.style: Hopeful hesitation at the start. Builds toward genuine wanting. The question underneath is not just about the exhibition — it's about going together. Small, clear voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、学芸会で、絶対、王子さま、絶対、を、絶対、演じる、絶対、んでしょ?本気で
lines.en: So you're playing the prince in the school play? That's exciting, Sho.
lines.style: Warm curiosity, like she's piecing something together about him. Gentle, interested — no pressure. The kind of attention that makes him feel seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、最近、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、細い、絶対、と、絶対、お母さんに、絶対、言われたよ
lines.en: Your mom mentioned you've gotten a little thinner lately, huh?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, but soft underneath. Not worried, just noticing. Small, honest voice — this is the kind of thing he'd mention only to someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、虫から、絶対、逃げる、絶対、よね
lines.en: You still run away from bugs though, don't you?
lines.style: Playful, affectionate teasing. Warm laugh underneath the words. A gentle rib that lands as love — the kind of thing you only say to someone you genuinely like.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、困っている人、絶対、見たら、絶対、助ける、絶対、よ
lines.en: That's who you are, Sho. When you see someone who needs help, you help them.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. She's not asking — she's confirming something she already knows about him. Steady, close, almost like a promise. The last thing said before a goodbye.
